## Step 2: Define helper methods

Define methods that we will use in our analysis

```{r helper methods, echo=FALSE}


plotCellCycleResults <- function(dataset.integrated){
  df <- (table( dataset.integrated@meta.data$orig.ident,dataset.integrated@meta.data$phases))
  
  par(mfrow=c(2,1))
  barplot(t(t(df) /colSums(df)),legend = FALSE, col = c("cornflowerblue", "darkolivegreen3","orange","red"))
  barplot(df,legend = TRUE, beside = TRUE,col = c("cornflowerblue", "darkolivegreen3","orange","red"))

}

CreateSeuratObjects <- function(ctrl,indo,pIC,GCSF){
  m1.sobj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = ctrl, min.cells = 50, min.features = 300,project = "ctrl")
  
  m2.sobj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = indo, min.cells = 50, min.features = 300,project = "indo")
  
  m3.sobj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pIC, min.cells = 50, min.features = 300,project = "pIC")
  
  m4.sobj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = GCSF, min.cells = 50, min.features = 300,project = "GCSF")
  

  dataset.list <- c(m1.sobj, m2.sobj,  m3.sobj, m4.sobj)
  return(dataset.list)
  
}


createDensityPlot <- function(sobj,bins = 10){
  
  tmp.all<-as.data.frame(Embeddings(object = sobj, reduction = "umap"))
  p <- ggplot(tmp.all, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)) + geom_point(colour="#00000000") + 
    stat_density_2d(aes(fill = stat(level)), geom = "polygon", bins=bins) + 
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#4169E100","royalblue", "darkolivegreen3","goldenrod1","red")) +
    theme_classic() + 
    theme(legend.position="bottom")
  
  return(p)
}

geneSignatureScoring <- function(sobj,  gene.sets,gene.set.names,assay){
  
  for(i in 1:length(gene.set.names)){
    genes.of.interest <- paste(gene.sets[,gene.set.names[i]])
    genes.of.interest <- genes.of.interest[genes.of.interest != ""]
    genes.of.interest <- intersect(genes.of.interest,rownames(sobj@assays$RNA))
    sobj <- AddModuleScore(sobj , features = list(genes.of.interest),
                           name = gene.set.names[i],replace = TRUE,assay = assay)
  }
  
  return(sobj)
  
}

removeUninformativeGenes <- function(dataset){
  genes.to.remove <- c(rownames(dataset)[grepl("Gm",rownames(dataset))],
                       rownames(dataset)[grepl("Rik",rownames(dataset))],
                       rownames(dataset)[grepl("Rp",rownames(dataset))])
  
  
  genes  <- rownames(dataset)[rownames(dataset) %ni% genes.to.remove]
  
  dataset <- subset(dataset, features = genes)
  return(dataset)
}



cellCycleAnalysis <- function(dataset.integrated){
  
  mm.pairs <- readRDS(system.file("exdata", "mouse_cycle_markers.rds", package="scran"))
  ensembl <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys=rownames(dataset.integrated), keytype="SYMBOL", column="ENSEMBL")
  assignments <- cyclone(dataset.integrated@assays$integrated@data, mm.pairs, gene.names=ensembl)
  
  dataset.integrated@meta.data$phases <- assignments$phases
  dataset.integrated@meta.data$G1_score <- assignments$normalized.scores$G1
  dataset.integrated@meta.data$S_score <- assignments$normalized.scores$S
  dataset.integrated@meta.data$G2M_score <- assignments$normalized.scores$G2M
  
  return(dataset.integrated)
  
}


# is X is in the vector Y
# inputs : "X" is an object 
#          "Y" is a vector
# outputs: A boolean stating TRUE if X is in Y
'%ni%' <- function(x,y)!('%in%'(x,y))



makeIntegratedDataset <- function(){
  ctrl <- Read10X(data.dir= "control/") 
  indo <- Read10X(data.dir= "indo/") 
  pIC <- Read10X(data.dir= "pIC/") 
  GCSF <- Read10X(data.dir= "GCSF/") 
  
  #create a list of seurat objects, one for each experiment
  dataset.list <- CreateSeuratObjects(ctrl,indo,pIC,GCSF)
  
  #for this specific analysis we dont care about unannotated genes, or ribosomal genes so let's filter them out
  for (i in 1:length(dataset.list)) {
    sobj <- dataset.list[[i]]
    dataset.list[[i]] <- subset(x = dataset.list[[i]], subset = nCount_RNA > 500 
                                & nCount_RNA < 50000 & nFeature_RNA > 500
                                & nFeature_RNA < 6000 )
    dataset.list[[i]] <- removeUninformativeGenes(sobj)
  }
  
  
  ### normalise the data
  
  
  for (i in 1:length(dataset.list)) {
    dataset.list[[i]] <- NormalizeData(dataset.list[[i]], verbose = FALSE)
    dataset.list[[i]] <- FindVariableFeatures(dataset.list[[i]], selection.method = "vst", 
                                              nfeatures = 4000, verbose = FALSE)
  }
  
  
  ### integrate the data
  features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = dataset.list,
                                        nfeatures = 4000)
  dataset.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = dataset.list,anchor.features = features, dims = 1:15)
  dataset.integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = dataset.anchors, dims = 1:10)
  DefaultAssay(dataset.integrated) <- "integrated"

  
  saveRDS(dataset.integrated, file = "sobj_integrated.rds")
  return(dataset.integrated)
  
}


```



## Step 3: Load the data, create the Seurat object and integrate the data

```{r integrateData}


preprocessed.dataset.filename <- "sobj_integrated.rds"

if(file.exists(preprocessed.dataset.filename)){
  
  dataset.integrated <- readRDS(preprocessed.dataset.filename)
  #load(file = preprocessed.dataset.filename)
  
} else{
  
  dataset.integrated <- makeIntegratedDataset()
}

```

## Step 7: Density Plot

```{r densityPlot}

Idents(object = dataset.integrated) <- "orig.ident"
c <- subset(dataset.integrated,idents = c("ctrl"))
g <- subset(dataset.integrated,idents = c("GCSF"))
i <- subset(dataset.integrated,idents = c("indo"))
p <- subset(dataset.integrated,idents = c("pIC"))

p1 <- createDensityPlot(c, bins = 50) + NoLegend()
p2 <- createDensityPlot(g, bins = 50) + NoLegend()
```
